entities.name: Yağmur Koçyiğit
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yağmur Koçyiğit is a Turkish volleyball player. She stands 185 cm tall and plays as an outside hitter. She plays for Fenerbahçe and signed a three-year contract with the team in July 2010. She has also played for Jamper Aguere from Spain, as well as Turkey's Eczacıbaşı Zentiva and Beşiktaş.
